# Concept

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A unit of thought in a knowledge organization system.

## Scope note

An abstract idea independent of its label. It's how we organize ideas for browsing and retrieval. a PKM Concept is based on the SKOS standard skos:Concept.
